text:
Jules: heads-up - small billing divergence in staging. compact ran then a 4m-late event caused an extra credit path.
Becky: ugh. any minimal repro?
Jules: example event (trimmed): ```{ "tenant_id": "tn-9", "req_id": "r-900", "tokens": 21, "fingerprint": "fp-900x", "ingest_ts": 1686000000 }``` we dedupe upstream by fingerprint+req.
Mateo: is finalizer accepting late arrivals and creating new entries despite compaction?
Jules: yes - compact produced a window snapshot, late event created another claim path finalizer accepted.
Nora: two levers: (A) widen compaction slop so compact waits longer, (B) keep slop tight but mark compacted windows as "handback" and make late arrivals produce repair intents instead of direct credits.
Becky: widening slop hurts near-realtime reporting. handback sounds promising - fewer surprises for dashboards.
Mateo: handback semantics? compact emits a marker like `window_handback:v1` and finalizer treats late events referencing a handback window as "repair_intent" that lands on audit stream.
Nora: repair intent sketch: ```{ "type":"repair_intent", "tenant":"tn-9", "window":"2026-03-22T10:00Z", "fps": ["fp-900x"], "payload": "proof://..." }``` then a repair worker applies idempotent adjustments.
Jules: good, and finalizer should emit audit.delta when applying repairs so UI + billing pick up deltas.
Mateo: add a small LRU index of recent fingerprints (24h TTL) in finalizer DB to resolve repairs cheaply. avoid scanning full compact.
Becky: retention question - keep raw events 7d? 48h? longer retention makes repairs simpler but costs more.
Nora: proposal: raw events 72h, compact proofs retained 30d. repair worker only allowed within 72h for full-proof fixes; beyond that, repairs require proof artifacts only.
Mateo: also need a CAS requirement on compact snapshot version when applying repairs to preserve ledger monotonicity. if CAS fails worker retries with reconcile flow.
Jules: UX: expose "repair note" in billing activity feed and a per-tenant repair_rate metric with alerting if rate spikes.
Becky: ops: throttle repair worker per-tenant to avoid IO storms during incidents.
Nora: action items: (1) Mateo - prototype handback marker + repair_intent flow; (2) Jules - finalizer change to emit audit.delta and support CAS + LRU index; (3) Becky - spec UI exposure and alerts.
Mateo: can spike this week, staging test next week.
ci-bot: branch metering-handback created and CI started (:rocket:)
Jules: thanks all. small slop + handback/repair seems lowest-risk to keep latency for most customers while fixing tails.
